_doc: M3 batch 1: FLUX.2 [dev] stills via ComfyUI (scripts/stills.py). Prompt = subject + the brief's shared still style, unchanged across the video. Four takes each (brief), seeds from 1929. Picks go in 'kept'. Batch 2 (after picks): N06, N08, N26 conditioned on the references; N15 from N14; N27 from N26; the LTX clips.
style: 1920s black-and-white documentary photograph, orthochromatic film look, high contrast, soft natural light, period clothing and interiors, 4:3 frame, clean image with no grain, no scratches, no text, no logos, no signage

ref_customer.subject: Character reference of one invented man in his thirties in 1928: a round clean-shaven face, dark hair slicked down and parted in the middle, white shirt with sleeve garters, a striped tie and a waistcoat. The same man shown twice side by side on a plain light-gray studio backdrop: full body from the front, and full body in three-quarter view. Identical face, hair and clothes in both views
ref_customer.note: reference for N08, N26, N27 (brief: consistency)

ref_machine.subject: Product photograph of a tall brass cabinet about the height of a man, on a plain light-gray studio backdrop: riveted brass panels, three round dials with needles, a row of toggle switches, vacuum tubes glowing faintly behind a small round glass window, and a single round glass bulb on top. A plain machine, not a robot: no face, no arms, no legs
ref_machine.note: reference for N06 and the running gag; brief guardrail: a plain cabinet, not a famous film robot

N02.subject: a 1920s family parlor at evening, a mother, a father and two children leaning in close toward a tall wooden cathedral-shaped radio set on a side table, a fringed lamp, patterned wallpaper, the family seen from behind and the side, their faces turned to the radio
N02.note: slow push to the radio; iris opens

N04.subject: a 1920s barbershop, a barber with a straight razor leaning down to whisper to a man in the chair, mirrors and bottles behind

N05.subject: a 1920s shoeshine stand on a city street corner, the shoeshine man kneeling at a customer's raised shoe and looking up with two fingers held up, the customer in a suit and hat holding a folded newspaper
N05.note: corner caption 'according to legend' added in code

N07.subject: a tall wall in a 1920s brokerage office covered edge to edge with large hand-drawn line charts on paper sheets, every line climbing steeply and running off the top of its sheet, a wooden ladder leaning against the wall, a clerk in shirtsleeves on the ladder pinning up another chart

N11.subject: a 1920s city skyline seen from street level looking up, one skyscraper rising far taller than all the others, so tall its spire disappears into the clouds, the other buildings stopping at a fraction of its height

N14.subject: a large windowless building with blank concrete walls and a flat roof in the middle of a cornfield at night, no windows at all, a pale glow rising from its roof edge into the night haze, viewed from a dirt road
N14.note: brief's example subject; slow pan; N15 adds the power plant to this frame (batch 2)
N14.v1_problem: rendered a glass pavilion with lit windows; the brief says windowless

N16a.subject: a long 1920s office corridor seen straight on, at its end an open office door, and through it a small office whose back wall has a second, smaller open door
N16a.note: first of three nested doors; zoom between stills

N16b.subject: a small cramped 1920s office seen straight on, a desk and a filing cabinet, the back wall with an even smaller open door leading to a tiny closet-sized office

N16c.subject: a tiny closet-sized 1920s office seen straight on through a small doorway, room for one small desk and one chair, a round hatbox on the desk
N16c.note: third nested door; leads into N17

N17.subject: a round hatbox on a wooden office desk, overflowing with small blank paper slips that spill onto the desk and the floor, a green-shaded desk lamp, a 1920s office
N17.note: IOUs in its hat; slips blank (no generated text)

N22.subject: one young woman in modern 2020s clothes, a hoodie, jeans and white sneakers, dancing the Charleston in the middle of a crowded 1920s dance hall among flappers in fringed dresses and men in suits, full-body wide shot
N22.note: one-frame insert; should match the C1 hall

N24.subject: a banker in a dark three-piece suit with one hand on the rim of a giant round brass gauge mounted on a marble wall, the gauge as big as a cartwheel, its face completely blank and pale with only short tick marks around the edge, no hands, no needle, no numbers, in a 1920s bank hall, seen from the side
N24.v1_problem: FLUX drew a clock with hands; the needle is a code overlay

N32.subject: an empty 1920s dance hall, floor buried knee-deep in paper ticker tape, one spotlight on a man in a tuxedo at an upright piano holding a megaphone, wide shot
N32.note: brief's example subject; generated wide for the pull-back

kf_C1a.subject: couples dancing the Charleston in a crowded 1920s dance hall, flappers and men in suits, full-body wide shot
kf_C1a.note: keyframe for clip C1 take 1 (LTX-2.3 image-to-video, batch 2)

kf_C1b.subject: couples dancing the Charleston in a crowded 1920s dance hall seen from a balcony at an angle, flappers in fringed dresses and men in suits kicking their heels, a jazz band on a small stage at the back, full-body wide shot

kf_C2.subject: long strips of paper ticker tape streaming down from the ceiling of a crowded 1920s dance hall onto dancing couples, the air full of falling tape

kf_C3.subject: close-up of two men's hands in 1920s suit cuffs passing a crumpled paper banknote from one hand to the other, a dance hall softly out of focus behind
kf_C3.note: keyframe for clip C3; the crumpled dollar callback

N06.subject: the brass cabinet machine from the reference image, strapped upright to a two-wheeled hand truck, wheeled along a 1920s city sidewalk past a shop window by a delivery man in a cap, passers-by in hats
N06.note: pan; bulb blinks (K overlay); batch 2, conditioned on the machine reference

N08.subject: the man from the reference image sitting in a 1920s barber chair, a white barber cape over him and his face half covered in shaving lather, signing a paper slip on a clipboard held out by a broker in a suit standing beside the chair
N08.note: after the 'Ten per cent down.' card; batch 2, conditioned on the customer reference

N26.subject: the man from the reference image standing proudly in a 1920s office, holding up a large hand-drawn chart with one line rising steeply, while paper banknotes stream out of his back trouser pocket and flutter to the floor behind him
N26.note: batch 2, conditioned on the customer reference; N27 is made from the pick

N15.subject: the same night scene as the reference image, the same windowless glowing building in the same cornfield from the same dirt road, now with a large power plant with tall smokestacks standing right beside the building, smoke rising
N15.note: dissolve target from N14; batch 2, conditioned on the N14 pick

N27.subject: the same man in the same office as the reference image, his whole face completely plastered with a thick white cream pie that has just been smashed into it, only cream visible where his face was, an empty pie tin falling away from his face, thick cream dripping down his collar and shirt, still holding up the chart
N27.note: hard cut from N26; batch 2, conditioned on the N26 pick
N27.v1_problem: the pie barely showed: each take stayed too close to its N26 reference
